scope: Standing historic Sidi Okba prayer hall, two shallow domes, minaret, attached tomb envelope and a representative short entry court. Modern complex buildings have separate scope.

primaryWrittenSources.facts: Architectural site survey gives 23.8 × 21.4 metres for the older prayer hall. It confirms the two-tier western minaret, adjacent domed tomb and 2009 modern complex.
Heritage inventory documents the old whitewashed covered hall with two roof domes, plain column arches and courtyard entrances.
Used only the recorded GPS and observed 149-degree facing for approximate historical hall registration. The western GPS is consistent with the independently mapped compound.
